item.title: We should share childhood stories more
item.description: – Children playing ball games, Roman artwork, 2nd century AD. Photo by: Jastrow via Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0 One of the best laughs I’ve had with my wife have been due to sharing childhood experiences. She’s also fond of my baby memories, or the really embarrassing experiences I’ve lived. To me, they are a reminder of how I’ve learned to be who I am. How I broke my friends leg When I was around 12 or 13 years old there was a zipline that went from a big eucalyptus tree to another. I was always careful around it, but it was fun to ride. One day my neighborhood friends were visiting. One of them was Pato. If I had to describe him in one word it’d be either bold, or reckless. You’ll see why shortly.
